services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether it's interior redecoration, wallpapering, exterior painting, or specialist finishes, we handle every detail with care.

services.title: Interior House Redecorating
services.desc: Full room and whole-house redecoration including wall preparation, painting, and finishing. We work methodically to protect your furniture and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Stripping
services.desc: Expert wallpaper removal and installation. We prepare walls properly and hang new paper with precision, ensuring perfect pattern matching and crisp edges.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Durable external paintwork and wood treatment. We use high-quality exterior paints and prepare surfaces thoroughly to withstand Newcastle weather.

services.title: Plastering & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Wall plastering, repairs, and joinery finishing to prepare surfaces for paint or wallpaper. Perfectly smooth results ready for final decoration.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Work
services.desc: Create standout feature walls with bold colours, paint effects, or specialty finishes. We help you get the look exactly right before we start.

services.title: Commercial & Residential Projects
services.desc: Reliable decorating for rental properties, office spaces, and commercial buildings. Fast turnaround and minimal disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: We take pride in thorough prep work—that's where the perfect finish really begins.
about_para_1: Changes Painting and Decorating was built on a simple idea: proper preparation and attention to detail transform any space. Based in Wallsend, we've spent over a decade perfecting our craft across Newcastle and surrounding areas. Darron and Steph lead a team that treats every project—whether a single bedroom or a whole house—with the same professional focus and care.
about_para_2: Our customers consistently recommend us because we don't cut corners. Every surface gets thoroughly prepared, every brush stroke counts, and we leave your home exactly as tidy as we found it. Whether it's wallpaper stripping, plastering repairs, or a fresh exterior paint, we take responsibility for the quality of our work and stand behind it.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute first class! I couldn't recommend these guys enough. Whole house redecorated professionally, attentively and efficiently. Left them to it and came home to a beautifully finished home. Darron and Steph made the whole process stress-free.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Quality was second to none. Probably the best decorators I have seen. All surfaces were prepared thoroughly prior to painting and glossing. The attention to detail was exceptional. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Caroline H.

reviews.text: Jason and his team did an absolutely fantastic job on our house. There was a great deal of wallpaper stripping and plastering required, as well as some joinery. They worked methodically, left the place clean every day, and finished on time. Excellent value.
reviews.author: Robert W.
